You interested in this A9G Droid here, eh? He's a good buy! Don't let those black marks around his neck fool you- they're just, uh, cosmetic. Okay, it's really carbon scoring, but not from blaster shots. The Droid got these marks from burning out its processor while on the job. See, A9G-Series Droids do their jobs so well, their owners tend to keep them working around the clock, continually processing information in their networks. The little guys work and work without a break until boom, their processors get fried and they shut down. But don't worry about this one. I personally refurbished the original processor, so it's as good as new.
